title: Murder at the Marigold Bindery
author: Hester Pryce-Lowell
tagline: A bookbinder reads a murder in thread, paste and paper.
description: When the village collector is found dead in her press room beside a half-sewn manuscript, widowed bookbinder Dot Pellow sees what the police cannot: the book has been rebound, twice. With a book fair in full swing, a regatta looming and eight suspects, she must read the clues before the killer reads her.
authorBio: Hester Pryce-Lowell grew up on the Cornish coast and spent thirty years repairing books in a small workshop. She lives near Truro with a stubborn cat.
